evidence.label: Current cold and retained-workdir validation
evidence.description: 15 successful serial measurements, seven perf stat events per row, identical cold/repeat commands and workdirs, and immutable DEF/LEF exports. All six LiveHD placements preserve the previous run's netlist, DEF/LEF and common timing/area/cell-count scores exactly. Cold placement wall time improves 15.9–22.3%; incremental wall time improves 17.3–25.3%. Warm QoR regressions on two designs remain.

evidence.label: Controlled Liberty and RC timing optimization profiles
evidence.description: Frozen AXI demux inputs, perf stat plus sampling, before/after compiler builds. Bulk Liberty input/comment processing and prepared RC ramp tail coefficients. Profiled synthesis 5.46→4.87 s, cold placement 81.84→66.59 s, incremental 62.27→51.14 s; netlists and DEF/LEF bytes match exactly. Also includes concurrent upstream merges; sampling overhead is separate from the table.

evidence.label: Earlier 08df1fa02 default synthesis/placement CPU profiles
evidence.description: Earlier classic/default-engine profiling, separate from the current aegraph resynthesis run. Fresh AXI demux runs with cycles:u sampling and perf stat. ABC Liberty parsing accounts for 17.61% of sampled synthesis cycles; Poisson solving remains 10.74% of sampled placement cycles. Sampling overhead is separate from the table.

evidence.label: Poisson optimization controls
evidence.description: The pushed DREAMPlace ff22aff change preserves reduction order. Earlier frozen lhdsuite controls improved placement wall time from 39.47 to 36.58 s and 27.94 to 24.94 s, with byte-identical DEF/LEF and identical timing, area and HPWL. Those use an earlier compiler and different inputs; they are separate from this corpus run.

evidence.label: Poisson kernel perf stat and numerical comparison
evidence.description: Three interleaved kernel measurements show about 3x lower time, with exact square and rectangular output-array equality.

evidence.label: Shared FakeRAM four-flow integration check
evidence.description: A separate 128x256 explicit SRAM fixture passes LiveHD synthesis/placement and HighTide synthesis/OpenROAD pre-CTS with the same generated Liberty and LEF. The three corpus cases above contain no retained SRAM macros under the measured profiles.

evidence.label: Original versus converted SRAM timing units
evidence.description: On one placed DEF, original ns/pF and normalized ps/fF models give identical setup/hold WNS/TNS and geometry area. FakeRAM remains an estimated black-box model.

remaining_issues: The incremental repeat worsens native OpenTimer and common OpenSTA WNS/TNS on AXI demux and FIFO; faster runtime does not imply better timing. The compiler reuses synthesis feedback but does not retain the previous placement as a best-QoR checkpoint.
Default GP iteration/convergence limits remain visible; these measurements do not establish timing or density target attainment.
